      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "adding a new generatetomany RPC incurs code bloat, extra test maintenance, and deprecation cycles when extending generateblock is more flexible and fixes reward fee issues",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2112898168",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "requiring an array rather than continuing to accept a string breaks backwards compatibility for scripts and automated tests using generateblock",
      "quote": "Although this RPC is only used by tests, I don't think we should be breaking backwards compatibility here. It's equally easy to determine whether this parameter is a string, so we can accept a string ",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added backwards compatibility support for string argument",
      "author_replies": [

      ],

      "status_by_id": "c:3336297423",
      "status_by_quote": "{ \"generateblock\", 0, \"outputs\", /*also_string=*/true},"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2971839554",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "omitting the transaction parameter in existing functional tests changes their behavior to mine the mempool instead of generating empty blocks",
      "quote": "Otherwise this should be backwards compatible, and mining the mempool instead of an empty block can be a behavior change in the tests.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author restored transactions=[] in tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2986422097"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2986422097",
      "status_by_quote": "I will add back the `transactions=[]` you are right that is a behavior change and this PR should not be changing that. T"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4289642909",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "limiting the RPC interface to equal splits rather than supporting custom reward amounts handicaps its usefulness for the sake of CLI convenience",
      "quote": "Custom rewards are the general solution, why not just implement that right away? It's useful to keep the CLI commands ergonomic, but I think it's a mistake to handicap the RPC interface just to make C",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "custom split rewards implemented",
